purpose: Post-hoc exploratory supplementary tests on saved formal OOF predictions; no model refits

hypotheses.AUC: H0: equal-fold mean within-fold weighted AUC = 0.5, two-sided normal approximation using cluster bootstrap SE
hypotheses.MAE: H0: weighted MAE(model)-weighted MAE(same-training Null)=0, two-sided
hypotheses.RMSE: H0: weighted RMSE(model)-weighted RMSE(same-training Null)=0, two-sided

auc_bootstrap: Resample entire species with replacement within fixed Fold x species label-composition strata (HIGH-only, LOW-only, mixed); keep each stratum size fixed; compute each fold AUC and equal-fold mean; no invalid-fold dropping
error_bootstrap: Paired resampling of the 48 species with count/exact observations over the complete CV design, using the same multiplicities for model and Null; recompute global weighted MAE and sqrt(global weighted MSE) in each replicate
confidence_intervals: Percentile cluster bootstrap 95%; not an exact inversion of the normal-approximation P

multiplicity.primary_supplement: BH across 3 metrics x 3 predictor models x 2 training methods = 18 tests within each fixed Design x EvalWeighting
multiplicity.endpoint_context: Also display per-endpoint BH over 3 models x 2 training methods = 6; do not select the smaller adjustment after results

null_auc: Structurally all within-fold scores tied; AUC=0.5, P=1, excluded from multiplicity families; not evidence of high precision
zero_variance_other: Report P as unavailable and flag; never report P=0 solely from zero bootstrap variance
inference_scope: Conditional on saved fitted OOF predictions, original fold allocation, and (AUC) outcome strata. Does not include refitting, fold selection, or model selection uncertainty.
